pokedexEntries.su: This Ultra Beast appeared from another world. It shows off its body, but whether that display is a boast or a threat remains unclear.

pokedexEntries.mo: A mysterious life-form called an Ultra Beast. Witnesses saw it pulverize a dump truck with a single punch.

pokedexEntries.us: Although it’s alien to this world and a danger here, it’s apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

pokedexEntries.um: Buzzwole goes around showing off its abnormally swollen muscles. It is one kind of Ultra Beast.
